name: Protoball
detailed_description:
After a long period of down time we have started development on Protoball again. We've started from scratch in Unreal Engine 5.6 and have rewritten the game entirely. We're currently testing and in development. Please be patient as we continue to improve and grow Protoball. 

Community Game Nights will return soon™ (Probably Tuesdays, check with the discord!) 
 


---------------------

WE ARE BACK IN EARLY ACCESS! After a small(long) time sleeping, the game is back!

Major Thanks to our awesome community that helped us play test to get the game ready for Early Access- you guys are the best! Seriously, not even joking, without the community this would just be a good idea. You're really the best. 

The year is 2113 - Protoball is a futuristic sports shooter. Protoball blends FPS/TPP shooting mechanics with sports game play. Players athletically jump, slide, run, grind, and dash their way around the arena trying to pass the Protoball through their opponents goal. Players can shoot curve balls, passes, bounce shots, fake-outs and more.

Shoot your opponent with an energy shield projectile, or use it to deflect the ball and make a big play. Curve the ball, pass the ball, bounce the ball and more... Your skill and creativity is the only real limit.

We are currently still in early development, and our vision for Protoball is grand. We're a small but dedicated indie duo developing this game for the love of the game. Join us and together we will make Protoball the best that it can be. If you join the discord and ask any of the Playtesters and you'll find that we've incorporated and implemented many of the community's suggestions and ideas. You can help too if you join the discord!

short_description: Protoball is a futuristic First Person Sports Shooter, a blend of basketball and soccer crossed with high tech futuristic style. Players athletically jump, slide, run, grind and dash around the arena trying to pass the Protoball through the opponents goal. This is the game you've been waiting for.
